visual_description: A heavy-duty plastic A-frame sign or a weather-sealed pouch attached to a t-post. Inside the clear plastic pouch is a visible document with the Department of the Interior header. Large bold text at the top reads: 'AUTHORIZED PALEONTOLOGICAL EXCAVATION IN PROGRESS'. It includes a contact number for the host museum.

constraints.logic: Acts as the 'Legal Shield' for the player's site.
constraints.background: Isolated on a neutral grey floor plane.
